meals.name: Honey-Garlic Salmon Sheet Pan
meals.description: Flaky salmon glazed with honey, garlic and a touch of soy, roasted on one pan with crispy baby potatoes and green beans. Sweet, savoury and almost no cleanup.

items: 1.5 lb baby potatoes, halved (quartered if large)

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper on a large sheet pan. Roast for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk together the glaze ingredients. Toss the green beans with the remaining 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt.
Push the potatoes to the edges, add the green beans, and lay the salmon in the middle. Season the salmon with salt and pepper and brush with half the glaze.
Roast 10–12 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily (145°F).
Brush the salmon with the rest of the glaze and serve with lemon wedges.
meals.leftovers: Keep in the fridge up to 3 days. Reheat gently in the microwave at half power, or enjoy the salmon cold over greens.

meals.name: Oven Baked Italian Sausage & Peppers
meals.description: Italian sausages roasted with sweet bell peppers and onions until soft and caramelized (fully cooked, never raw), finished with a little marinara and melted mozzarella. Served with warm garlic bread.
meals.on_the_side: Hot Italian sausage swap or chili flakes

meals.name: Steak Burrito Bowls
meals.description: Seared, lightly seasoned steak over garlic-lime rice with black beans, sweet corn, shredded cheese and sour cream. Easy to pack for lunch the next day.
meals.on_the_side: Salsa, hot sauce and pickled jalapeños. No cilantro.

items: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (15 oz) sweet corn, drained (or 1.5 cups frozen)

steps: Melt the butter in a pot, add the garlic for 30 seconds, then cook the rice according to the package. When it's done, stir in the lime zest and juice.
Pat the steak dry and rub all over with the seasoning.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear the steak 4–5 minutes per side for medium (130–135°F). Rest 5 minutes, then slice thin against the grain.
While the steak rests, warm the beans and corn together in the same skillet for 3–4 minutes with a pinch of salt.
Build the bowls: rice, beans and corn, steak, cheese and a spoonful of sour cream.
meals.leftovers: Pack the rice, beans and steak together, and keep the cheese and sour cream separate. Microwave 1.5–2 minutes, then add the toppings.

shopping.name: Chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, smoked paprika

meals.name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender strips of beef and crisp broccoli in a glossy, savoury garlic-ginger sauce, served over fluffy white rice. Better than takeout and faster too.

items: 1.5 lb flank or sirloin steak, sliced thin against the grain
1 tbsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp soy sauce (to coat the beef)

steps: Start the rice according to the package.
Toss the beef with 1 tbsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Whisk the sauce ingredients in a bowl.
In a large skillet, add the broccoli and 1/4 cup water. Cover and steam 3 minutes until bright green and crisp-tender. Remove and wipe the pan dry.
Heat 1 tbsp oil over high. Sear half the beef in a single layer, about 2 minutes per side. Remove, then repeat with the remaining oil and beef.
Lower the heat to medium, add the garlic and ginger, and stir 30 seconds. Pour in the sauce and simmer 1–2 minutes until glossy and thick.
Return the beef and broccoli and toss to coat. Serve over rice with sesame seeds.
meals.leftovers: Keeps up to 4 days. Microwave 1.5–2 minutes, with a splash of water over the rice.

shopping.name: Broccoli
shopping.note: 2 large heads or two 12 oz bags of florets

meals.name: Shrimp Tacos with Crunchy Slaw
meals.description: Garlic-lime shrimp seared in a hot pan and tucked into warm flour tortillas with a crunchy cabbage-lime slaw, avocado and a cool lime crema.
meals.on_the_side: Creamy chipotle sauce and hot sauce. No cilantro, no raw onion.

items: 1.5 lb large raw shrimp, peeled and deveined (thawed if frozen)
1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt
1–2 tsp adobo sauce from the chipotle can (start with 1)

steps: Stir together the slaw ingredients, the lime crema, and the chipotle sauce in three separate bowls. Refrigerate.
Pat the shrimp very dry and toss with the paprika, cumin, garlic powder and salt.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook the shrimp in a single layer, 1.5–2 minutes per side, until pink. Add the garlic and a squeeze of lime for the last 30 seconds.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet, 20–30 seconds per side.
Build the tacos: slaw, shrimp, avocado, cotija and a drizzle of lime crema.
meals.leftovers: Store the shrimp, slaw and toppings separately. Reheat the shrimp for 30–45 seconds, or eat it cold. Slice the avocado fresh for lunch.
